title: LiveActionAOV Standalone Tool for Batch VFX Pass Generation
summary: An open-source standalone application that generates high-quality VFX passes like depth, normals, and segmentation masks from live-action footage. It automates the creation of Nuke-compatible sidecar EXR files while managing scene-linear colorspace conversions and batch processing.
research_notes: Created specifically for Nuke compositors to provide reliable, multi-channel AI passes without the complexity of node-based AI graphs.

evolution.summary: Developed from a manual ComfyUI workflow into a unified standalone GUI/CLI tool to solve flicker and colorspace issues in professional VFX pipelines. Recent updates integrated SAM 3 for high-precision alpha refinement and semantic masking.
